brand.name: SplitsPro
brand.philosophy: We don't just install air conditioners — we craft comfort for every home.

colors.rules: Minimal palette. Absolutely NO colorful gradients. Use SplitsPro blue exclusively for primary CTA buttons, links, or highly selective subtle accents. Use white and light grey heavily for large generous sections to create an architectural, gallery-like feel.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

typography.rules: CRITICAL: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Outfit, or Satoshi. Never use generic SaaS font pairings. Playfair Display must be used for large display headings to evoke high-end editorial and architectural luxury. Manrope for clean, functional body copy. Do not over-bold headings; prefer lighter, regular, or medium weights for elegance.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing. Use py-24, py-32, or py-40 for sections. Container max-w-7xl mx-auto.
spacing_and_layout.white_space: Embrace negative space to signal luxury. Elements should never feel cramped or boxed in.
spacing_and_layout.radius: Use rounded-none or rounded-sm. NO heavy rounding, to maintain a sharp, architectural feel.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Very soft, ambient shadows: shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] or none. NO harsh or dark dropshadows.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #E5E5EA for dividers. Very subtle and minimal.
spacing_and_layout.rules: NO dashboard layouts. NO software-style cards. NO cluttered grid components. Use full-bleed cinematic imagery where possible, mixed with asymmetric 2-column text-image blocks.

motion.rules: Extremely restrained. Subtle fade-ins and slide-ups (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) using framer-motion (duration 0.8s, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]). Smooth momentum scroll using Lenis. Slow image reveal/scale (scale 1.05 to 1 on load). Small button hover scale (1.02). No bouncy or fast distracting animations.

components.buttons: Primary: Solid #1E3A8A, text #FFFFFF, no border, sharp corners or very slight radius (rounded-sm), px-8 py-4. Secondary: Border 1px solid #1D1D1F, transparent bg, text #1D1D1F. Hover states: opacity shift or slight scale. DO NOT use SaaS pill shapes.
components.floating_cta: Sticky bottom-right or bottom-center. High-contrast floating button 'Get Free Quote' (desktop) and 'Call Now' (mobile).
components.hero_quote_form: Minimalist inputs, integrated into a glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80) or solid white floating panel over the hero image. Clean borders, 1px solid #E5E5EA, minimal padding. Custom Shadcn components (Input, Select, Button).
components.accordion: FAQ accordion must be elegant, using Shadcn. Border-bottom only (no side borders), large click area, sophisticated plus/minus icon.
components.slider: Before & After comparison slider with clear draggable center line. Use raw HTML/Tailwind and standard JS logic if a library isn't available, keep it clean.

sections_blueprint.navigation: Transparent over hero initially, turning solid white with subtle bottom border on scroll. Sticky. Links: Home, Split Systems, Ducted, Cleaning, Gallery, Service Areas, About, Contact, Get Quote.
sections_blueprint.hero: Full-bleed architectural home interior image. Light overlay (bg-black/20) just enough for readability. Headline 'Crafted Comfort For Every Home'. Subheading about precision. The Quote form should be directly floating in the hero section.
sections_blueprint.brand_philosophy: Editorial section. Massive Playfair Display typography. Lots of whitespace. 'We don't just install air conditioners — we craft comfort for every home.'
sections_blueprint.featured_services: Asymmetric bento or 1-column alternating blocks (Split, Ducted, Cleaning, Repairs). Large imagery, minimal text. No SaaS cards.
sections_blueprint.why_choose_us: No fake stats/counters. Typographic list of genuine trust markers (Licensed & Insured, Premium Workmanship) with elegant typography and subtle checkmarks.
sections_blueprint.real_gallery: Masonry or horizontal scroll gallery of installations. Large touch targets.
sections_blueprint.before_and_after: Image comparison slider highlighting clean professional finish vs old ACs.
sections_blueprint.reviews: Simple text-focused testimonials. No heavy cards. Clean quotes in serif font.
sections_blueprint.our_process: 4-step timeline (Home Assessment, Tailored Comfort Plan, Precision Installation, Enjoy Lasting Comfort). Numbered large typography (01, 02, 03, 04) with vertical or horizontal elegant lines.
sections_blueprint.service_areas: Typographic, clean list of Western Sydney suburbs (Bass Hill, Bankstown, Parramatta, etc).
sections_blueprint.faq: Accordion style, elegant, border bottom only.
sections_blueprint.footer: Large footer. Dark charcoal bg (#1D1D1F) or solid white with top border. Google maps embed, ABN, phone, opening hours, quick links, service areas, social. NO email displayed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium luxury architectural landing page. DO NOT use generic SaaS layouts, soft blobs, or grid cards with drop shadows.
Install and use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text via Google Fonts. (e.g. `font-serif` mapped to Playfair, `font-sans` mapped to Manrope).
Implement smooth scrolling with Lenis and very subtle Framer Motion reveals on scroll.
Build the Quote form in the hero with functional fields (Name, Phone, Suburb, Service, Message) using Shadcn components customized to look premium.
Ensure the floating Get Free Quote / Call Now buttons are sticky and responsive.
Use ONLY the exact minimal color palette provided: #FFFFFF, #F5F5F7, #1D1D1F, #1E3A8A.
Remove all dashboard-like shadows, colorful gradients, and oversized generic icons. Do not use fake stats.
Integrate Phosphor Icons or Lucide (very thin/light weights) for any iconography, but keep it sparse.
Ensure contrast is perfect and responsive scaling is seamless for mobile.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, not heavy shadows.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
